verdict_reason: Test correctly tracks the aggregate/content composition rename with no correctness bugs, but the refactor left ~9 dead no-op .notification(...) builder calls and one 20-line hand-rolled NotificationView anonymous class that duplicates an existing production carrier.

todos.issue: Builder chains call .notification(Notification.builder().build()) then immediately overwrite it with a second .notification(...) call (e.g. lines 1341-1342 are byte-identical duplicates; also seen at ~254-256, 1052-1054, 1087-1089, 1122-1124, 1216-1218, 1325-1327, 1360-1362, 1501-1503, 1553-1555) — the first call is dead code left over from the NotificationBase -> Notification composition refactor
todos.fix: Remove the redundant no-op .notification(Notification.builder().build()) call wherever a second .notification(...) call follows it in the same builder chain

todos.issue: NotificationViewBuilder.build() was rewritten to a 20-line anonymous class implementing every NotificationView getter, duplicating the production NotificationView.Data carrier class (same package, public all-args constructor with the same field order) that exists exactly for this purpose
todos.fix: Replace the anonymous class with new NotificationView.Data(ref, 0L, s, c, o, cm, cor, cee, t)
